answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The mirror lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the lotus is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Reaching the ridge of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
